name: yt-screen-warp
title: On-Screen Display Effect
description: Makes footage read as a physical display: a slight 3D tilt, pixel grid, scanlines, vignette and sheen fade in over a screen inset in the host box. The host's footage comes in through a template with data-slot="yt-screen-warp-screen"; helpers ytScreenOn/ytScreenOff wire the same look onto any media wrapper.
